items.difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that tor amplitude in a bounded interval is preserved by the derived pullback along a morphism of ringed sites (statement lines 12542-12550). The proof (proof lines 12552-12563) replaces E by a complex of flat modules vanishing outside the interval, pulls it back, and applies the same characterisation to the pulled-back complex. H2: one computation with the characterisation used twice.
